video_title: The UK Has A Global Megacity Hiding In Plain Sight
evidence: SponsorRadar records Ekster sponsoring CityEd.'s August 14, 2026 English-language YouTube video with the explicit disclosure that Ekster sponsored the video and a creator-specific CITYED26 offer. SponsorRadar tracks 631 Ekster sponsorships across 260 creators and repeated spend with small and mid-size channels. CityEd. had about 43.3K subscribers on August 23, 2026. Ekster's official press page lists partnerships@ekster.com specifically for Influencer inquiries, and its official ambassador program recruits social-media creators with commissions and free products.
